Method of Attack: UEFI rootkit used for firmware-level malware attacks
Abuse of firmware vulnerabilities to persist in system firmware
Firmware filesystem scanning and detection evasion
Impacted Systems: Systems with UEFI firmware vulnerable to rootkits
Attack Vector: Malicious code injection in SPI flash memory
Indicators of Compromise: UEFI rootkit presence in firmware filesystem
Anomalies detected in SPI flash by UEFI scanner
